summary.good: Air quality is satisfactory and poses little or no health risk.
summary.moderate: Air quality is acceptable. Very sensitive individuals should observe symptoms.
summary.unhealthy_sensitive: Sensitive groups (asthma, children, seniors) may experience irritation.
summary.unhealthy: Everyone may begin to experience health effects; sensitive groups more seriously.
summary.very_unhealthy: Health alert: serious risk of harm for entire population. Remain indoors.
summary.hazardous: Health emergency: life-threatening conditions for all residents.

advice.good: Air quality is clean. Ideal time for outdoor exercise, runs, and window ventilation.
advice.moderate: Acceptable air quality. Unusually sensitive people should consider limiting heavy exertion.
advice.unhealthy_sensitive: Sensitive individuals should wear an N95 mask outdoors and limit prolonged workouts.
advice.unhealthy: Avoid strenuous outdoor exertion. Close windows facing traffic and run HEPA air purifiers.
advice.very_unhealthy: Stay strictly indoors. Seal room drafts and operate continuous HEPA filtration.
advice.hazardous: Emergency condition. Remain strictly inside. Avoid all outdoor physical activity.
